gem_guidance.text: Regarding the gem slots, you can tailor these to your specific needs. The gear set below is just an example of matching the socket bonuses with an emphasis on bonus healing from teardrop cuts. Experimenting with different setups will be key in fine-tuning your gear. Also, a reminder that Quick Lionseye will become available if that is something that interests you.

title: Burning Crusade Classic Holy Paladin Healing Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 5 Gear Guide - Wowhead
